description: Available high-level tasks the NPC may propose. Tasks are declarative; execution is handled by the game.
rules: Do NOT invent tasks not listed here.
Do NOT set positions, transforms, health, or inventory directly.
Use tasks to express intent, not implementation details.

tasks.name: wait
tasks.description: Pause or idle for a short duration.

tasks.name: move_to_cell
tasks.description: Move toward a grid cell using navigation.

tasks.name: move_to_object
tasks.description: Move toward a known object or entity.

tasks.name: bark
tasks.description: Emit a bark or alert sound.

tasks.name: emote
tasks.description: Display a body-language or facial emote.
